name: DAG Budget Scheduling Benchmark Suite
description: Deterministic benchmark suite for equal-budget evaluation of search-based DAG workflow schedulers. Companion artifact of the paper "Equal-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search versus Randomized Restart List Scheduling for DAG Workflows: A Preregistered, Verifier-Backed Failure-Boundary Study". Components: Instance generators — deterministic (byte-exact replay): ladder families, shape families (narrow-deep / hetero-exec / high-CCR), A-axis instances. Scheduler arms — textbook-UCT faithful reimplementation, two-tier pilot (segmented hard budget + truncated candidates), four-arm baseline suite (constructive family / best-of-B restarts / FBI+ILS local search / hybrid tree-search arm). Independent verifier — external schedule verifier (feasibility, precedence, communication cost, makespan recompute) sharing no code with schedulers. Result files — frozen headline artifacts (B0 branch-magnitude verdict, B4 phase-transition adjudication, C1 shape-pilot pairs, C2-R7 three-anchor scale analysis, P1 Stage-2 statistics). Reproduction discipline: equal evaluated-search budget across arms (one evaluated search per unit); every reported schedule passes the independent verifier; density discipline E/N in [1,5].
